name: PAYE
note: Tax withheld from employees' pay. Due by the 9th of the following month.

name: Affordable Housing Levy
note: Employer and employee each contribute a percentage of gross pay. Paid together with PAYE.

name: SHIF (health insurance)
note: Social Health Insurance Fund contributions deducted from employees' pay and remitted monthly.

name: NSSF
note: Employer and employee pension contributions, due by the 15th of the following month.

name: NITA levy
note: Industrial training levy, a fixed amount per employee each month.

name: VAT Return
note: Monthly VAT return and payment for VAT-registered businesses, due by the 20th of the following month.

name: Turnover Tax
note: Applies only if your annual turnover falls within the turnover tax range. Check with KRA whether you qualify.

name: Income tax instalment
note: Advance income tax paid in instalments if you expect to owe more than the minimum threshold. Dates assume a December year-end.

name: Annual income tax return
note: Due by 30 June for a December year-end. File even if you made no income (a nil return).

name: Single business permit renewal
note: Annual renewal of your county business permit. The deadline differs between counties, so confirm yours.

name: Company annual returns
note: Placeholder date. Edit this to your company's actual due date for annual returns.

name: Data protection registration
note: Businesses that handle personal data must register with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner and renew. Placeholder date: set it from your certificate.
